story.title: (ENR SUCC) DEV & TEST - 834E/U AR PASSE Transaction Effective Date Logic Update - EDI

scenarios.title: Identify inbound Eligibility, Assessment, and Maintenance dates for transaction effective date selection

flagged.why: the edge case never tests an edge condition

gaps: Id TC_TS001_003 has Status field "Edge" but no Test Step Expected Result describes an error, a rejection, or an absent record. Example Expected Result text: "The file is received and processed, but there is no TM evidence that the later maintenance date 20250301 becomes the transaction-driving date for the member transaction."

Id TC_TS001_003 has Status field "Edge" but no Test Step Expected Result describes an error, a rejection, or an absent record. Example Expected Result text: "The FACETS eligibility row for the submitted member SSN does not show 2025-03-01 as the loaded transaction effective date."

Id TC_TS001_003 has Status field "Edge" but no Test Step Expected Result describes an error, a rejection, or an absent record. Example Expected Result text: "No FACETS processed eligibility row uses 2025-03-01 as the transaction effective date, the persisted value remains aligned to the first received date 2025-02-01, and the later maintenance date is absent as a transaction-driving loaded value."

scenarios.title: Use Eligibility Date for new enrollment before eligibility span begins regardless of Assessment Date
Use Assessment Date for current eligibility change when Assessment Date changes
Use Assessment Date and preserve relevant fields when only Assessment Date changes

flagged.why: the negative case is outside this scenario
the Edge case never tests an edge condition

gaps: Status field contains "Negative" for Id "TC_TS004_002", while the source scenario type is "Positive"

Description field contains "Validate that the assessment-date-driven transaction effective date behavior is not the applicable outcome when the inbound 834 changes Assessment Date and also changes one relevant field" for Id "TC_TS004_002", which tests a different condition than the scenario "when only Assessment Date changes"

Test Step Expected Result field for step 12 contains "No new assessment-date-driven transaction effective date is evidenced for this submission because Assessment Date did not change. The member retains the prior stored effective-date state, demonstrating the scenario condition was not met and no assessment-date-based update occurred.", which does not describe an error, a rejection, or an absent record for Edge id "TC_TS004_003"

scenarios.title: Use Eligibility Date for future eligibility relevant-field changes when Assessment Date is unchanged

Test Step Expected Result step 9 claims "no qualifying update is established for this scenario because the Assessment Date in the submitted file changed from baseline" in field Test Step Expected Result, but the SQL shown in Test Step Description filters only "AND D.KEY_ID IN (73)"
